item.title: Searches for electric cars fall in Donegal despite national rise
item.description: Research by DoneDeal shows searches for second-hand electric vehicles in Donegal are down 22%, despite a national rise of 17%. The data looked at the year on year figures for January. Searches for petrol cars in Donegal increased by 8%, while diesel searches fell by 4%.
